verdict.rationale: The evidence shows notes, feedback and hiring-team records exist in Ashby (searchable via MCP), and feedback can be submitted from Slack. Permission levels can be scoped globally or to specific departments and jobs, and AI tools respect those permissions, which gives some visibility control. Missing for 10: any evidence of @mentions, task assignment, shared-notes collaboration workflows, feedback-specific visibility rules for sensitive feedback, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
